note_text: A variable stores a value in memory. Python uses assignment with the equals sign, and variable names should be meaningful.
A for loop repeats a block of code for each item in a sequence. Indentation defines the loop body in Python.
Functions group reusable instructions. Parameters receive input values and return sends a result to the caller.
An algorithm is a finite sequence of steps used to solve a problem. Pseudocode describes logic before implementation.
Binary search finds a target in a sorted array by repeatedly checking the middle element and halving the search range.
A stack follows last-in first-out order. Push adds an item and pop removes the most recent item.
A queue follows first-in first-out order. Enqueue inserts at the rear and dequeue removes from the front.
A linked list stores nodes connected by references. Each node contains data and a pointer to the next node.
Big O notation describes how an algorithm's time or space requirement grows with input size.
Merge sort divides an array, sorts each half recursively, and merges the sorted halves in O(n log n) time.
A database table contains rows and columns. A primary key uniquely identifies each record.
SQL SELECT retrieves columns from a table, while WHERE filters rows that meet a condition.
A database JOIN combines related rows from two tables using a matching column.
Normalization reduces redundant data by organizing attributes into related tables and applying normal forms.
An index can speed up database queries, but it requires storage and can slow down writes.
Machine learning uses data to learn patterns. Supervised learning trains on examples with known labels.
A training set fits a model and a test set estimates performance on unseen examples.
Overfitting occurs when a model memorizes training details and performs poorly on new data.
Precision is the fraction of predicted positives that are correct; recall is the fraction of actual positives found.
A confusion matrix compares predicted labels with true labels and helps inspect classification errors.
Mean is the arithmetic average. Median is the middle value after observations are ordered.
Standard deviation measures spread around the mean and is expressed in the same units as the data.
Probability ranges from zero to one and quantifies how likely an event is.
A normal distribution is symmetric and bell-shaped, with mean, median, and mode at its center.
An API defines how software components communicate through requests, responses, and agreed data formats.
HTML structures a web page, CSS controls presentation, and JavaScript adds interactive behavior.
HTTP status code 404 indicates that a requested resource was not found.
Responsive design adapts layouts to screen sizes using flexible grids and media queries.
A Git commit records a snapshot of project changes. Branches let developers work on features separately.
Unit tests check small components in isolation, while integration tests examine how components work together.
Code review helps detect defects, improve readability, and share knowledge before changes are merged.
A software requirement states a user need or system behavior and should be testable and unambiguous.
Encryption transforms readable data into ciphertext using an algorithm and key.
Phishing messages impersonate trusted sources to trick people into revealing credentials or opening harmful links.
Multi-factor authentication combines independent evidence such as a password and a one-time code.
Least privilege gives each user or process only the permissions needed for its task.
A neural network uses connected layers of units to learn patterns by adjusting weights during training.
Natural language processing studies methods for analyzing and generating human language.
Generative AI can produce text or code, but outputs may contain unsupported claims and require verification.
A search engine indexes documents and ranks results based on relevance signals and query terms.
TF-IDF gives higher weight to terms frequent in one document but uncommon across the collection.
Cosine similarity compares vector directions and is often used to rank text documents by similarity.
A CSV file stores tabular data as comma-separated values and can be read using pandas.
A dataframe organizes data into labeled rows and columns. Filtering and grouping help summarize observations.
Missing values should be inspected before choosing whether to remove, impute, or flag them.
A bar chart compares categories, while a line chart is useful for showing change over time.
A function can be tested with normal inputs, edge cases, and invalid values to expose defects.
A hash table maps keys to values and typically supports average constant-time lookup.
A foreign key links a record to a key in another table and helps maintain referential integrity.
Cross-validation repeats training and validation across folds to estimate how a model generalizes.
A short note: recursion calls the same function again until a base case stops it.
Example code: for i in range(5): print(i). The loop prints values from zero through four.
In SQL, SELECT name FROM Students WHERE mark >= 80; retrieves names meeting a score condition.
CSS media query: @media (max-width: 600px) changes styles for smaller screens.
The model achieved high precision but low recall, so many relevant positive examples were missed.
A password manager stores unique credentials; phishing-resistant authentication can reduce account compromise.
A dashboard uses charts and summary metrics to communicate patterns in a dataset.
A REST endpoint commonly represents a resource and uses HTTP methods such as GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE.
A compiler translates source code into another representation and reports syntax or type errors.
A training dataset should represent expected use cases; biased or unbalanced examples can harm performance.
Collect only data needed for the task, restrict access, and remove personal identifiers where possible.
A topic tag is a suggestion rather than a fact; students should be able to correct or remove it.
A model card documents intended use, limitations, evaluation, and known risks of a machine-learning system.
Copyright and licence terms determine whether educational text can be reused or redistributed.
A vector representation encodes text numerically so a classifier or similarity system can compare notes.
A dictionary in Python maps unique keys to values and supports lookup by key.
A database transaction groups operations and should preserve atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability.
The median is robust to extreme outliers, while the mean can be pulled toward very large or small values.
A unit test for binary search should cover an empty list, a missing target, and a target at either boundary.
Use HTTPS to protect data in transit; validate inputs and avoid logging secrets or passwords.
A student note mentions Python lists, SQL tables, and a small chart; tags may cover several subjects.
A machine-learning pipeline can clean text, convert it to TF-IDF features, and train a one-vs-rest classifier.
